enlarged_p0_p1.statement: The finite reduced cross term makes a source-response extension plausible, but no full tensor renormalized pairing, gauge descent or corner matching is certified.

fixed_boundary_p1.statement: The full tensor horizontal class is zero and remains zero under every declared local counterterm ambiguity.

minimal_required_enlargement.statement: Any repair must leave the declared ambiguity class: add at least one independent boundary canonical momentum/edge variable (naturally a renormalized p0/p1 source-response partner) or change the bulk Hessian, for example through an Einstein-Hilbert scale/compensator.

p0_p0_linear_divergence.statement: The unrenormalized cut density has a generic O(r) p0-p0 divergence. Its coefficient is an exact u derivative, so any whole-I cancellation is a corner condition, not a finite cutwise Lee-Wald form.

claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC full-tensor potential theorem excludes a nondegenerate fixed-boundary Einstein-radiative form obtained solely through local Lee-Wald/JKM ambiguities of the pure C^2 action. It does not exclude an enlarged p0/p1 source-response phase space, construct Bondi BV-BFV ghosts/antifields, classify Coulombic or logarithmic data, match I-/i0/I+, compute P0 or D_M charges, or establish causal, particle, scattering, stability, positivity, unitarity or quantum claims.

complete_local_counterterm_ansatz.action_boundary_term: L -> L+dB gives Theta -> Theta+delta B and changes omega by delta_1 delta_2 B-delta_2 delta_1 B=0
complete_local_counterterm_ansatz.category: all finite-order local covariant ambiguities made from the existing metric, boundary normal/conformal frame and their finite jets, with no new independent boundary field
complete_local_counterterm_ansatz.classification: Every local Lee-Wald/JKM ambiguity without new fields is the sum of these two types; coefficients and tensor contractions cannot change the horizontal cohomology class.
complete_local_counterterm_ansatz.derivative_bound: arbitrary finite order N; therefore includes the first sufficient order <=3 for a four-derivative bulk action
excluded_enlargements: an independent boundary momentum or edge mode
retaining p0 as a dynamical boundary source without a certified renormalized pairing
adding an Einstein-Hilbert or compensator term to the bulk action
complete_local_counterterm_ansatz.potential_corner_term: Theta -> Theta+dY gives omega -> omega+d(delta_1 Y[h2]-delta_2 Y[h1])

Coulombic_data.value: set to zero in this radiative restriction; mass and angular-momentum aspects are not classified

I_minus_i0_matching.value: the theorem is local to I+ and compact-u-support tests

antifields.value: no null-boundary BV dual falloff or BFV pairing is constructed

fields.value: smooth full metric perturbations h_ab; theorem restriction delta Ricci_ab=0, fixed leading unphysical metric, h_AB=r*C_AB(u,x)+O(1), q^AB C_AB=0, C_AB compactly supported in u

ghosts.value: linear diffeomorphism and Weyl parameters whose boundary jets preserve Omega=0, the fixed conformal two-metric, and the declared Einstein-radiative subcarrier

p0_boundary_metric_data.value: excluded by fixed-boundary condition; its possible source-response pairing with p1 is not ruled out

polyhomogeneous_logs_and_Jordan_data.value: not reconstructed in the full tensor Bondi complex

radiative_data.value: tracefree Bondi shear C_AB(u,x), compact support in u for the obstruction pairing

flat_einstein_restriction.condition: delta Ricci_ab=0 (hence delta R=0) for each Jacobi field

four_dimensional_curvature_identity.consequence: Modulo the Euler density, the quadratic bulk C^2 Hessian is built only from delta Ricci_ab and delta R.

nonexact_news_witness.conclusion: f*g_u-g*f_u is not a total u derivative in the finite local jet algebra.

full_tensor_lee_wald_derivation.flat_background_specialization: Cbar=0, but delta(nabla P) is retained; the formula is tensorial before Bondi or TT reduction

next_gate: Introduce and classify the minimal independent boundary momentum/source-response variable, then derive the full tensor p0/p1 Bondi constraint, ghost, antifield and corner complex and test its renormalized pairing.

obstruction_theorem.Einstein_restriction: On any pair of flat Einstein Jacobi fields the non-topological quadratic Hessian vanishes; the Euler contribution has horizontally exact Lee-Wald current.
obstruction_theorem.ambiguity_invariance: delta B leaves omega unchanged and dY changes only its horizontal representative, so every counterterm in the complete declared local ansatz retains the zero class.
obstruction_theorem.conclusion: No local counterterm/corner ambiguity built only from the existing metric jets can produce a finite nondegenerate fixed-boundary Einstein-radiative symplectic form in pure C^2 gravity.
obstruction_theorem.target_form_witness: A nondegenerate Einstein-radiative form would restrict on one polarization to f*g_u-g*f_u. Its Euler derivatives are (2*g_u,-2*f_u), so it is not horizontally exact.
obstruction_theorem.wave_packet_test: For compact-u-support radiation all endpoint and sphere-divergence terms integrate to zero. Hence an exact representative pairs every such wave packet to zero and is radical.

scope.background: Minkowski space in one fixed conformal completion
scope.boundaries: local cuts of I+; compact-support-in-u radiative test subspace
scope.carrier: full metric tensor in the bulk, restricted for the no-go to flat Einstein Jacobi fields with Bondi shear C_AB/r
scope.charge_sector: zero Coulombic aspects; fixed leading unphysical boundary metric
scope.ell: all radiative tensor harmonics for which the Einstein Jacobi and compact-u-support conditions hold
scope.k: radial Bondi expansion, not compact momentum
scope.m: all; angular integration is local and the witness survives restriction to one component
scope.parity: both tracefree sphere-tensor polarizations; one polarization supplies the nonexactness witness
scope.theory: linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity
